steps.body: Different fractions can name the SAME amount. Fold a halves strip once more and 1/2 becomes 2/4 — new numbers, identical length.
steps.narration: Different fractions can name the SAME amount. Fold a halves strip once more and 1/2 becomes 2/4 — new numbers, identical length.

widget.prompt: Find a fraction equal to 1/2 using fourths: build it.
widget.successFeedback: 2/4 — twice as many pieces, each half as big, and the shaded length has not moved at all.
widget.lowFeedback: Your shaded bar is shorter than the target half. Shade more — raise the numerator, or use fewer parts.
widget.highFeedback: Your shaded bar is longer than half. Shade less — lower the numerator, or split into more parts.

commonFractions.feedback: 1/4 is only half as much as 1/2; renaming must keep the length identical.
3/4 overshoots past a half — the shaded part grew instead of being renamed.

predict.prompt: Cutting every piece of 1/2 in two, what happens to the shaded length?
predict.reveal: More cuts create more, smaller pieces — you hold twice as many of half-sized pieces, so the length is unchanged.

cml.actionGoal: Cut, count, and compare equal pieces to see what g3f strip equiv really names.
invariants: A fraction names equal shares of ONE whole: the denominator says how many equal pieces the whole became, and the numerator counts them, which is what makes g3f strip equiv comparable at all.
misconceptions: Calling unequal pieces fractions, reading the denominator as a count, or comparing fractions that came from different-sized wholes.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If the whole changed size, which of these comparisons would stop being trustworthy?

widget.prompt: Scale 1/2 by ×3 on top and bottom. What is the new numerator?

commonErrors.feedback: Scaling by ×3 must reach the top as well — leaving it alone changes the fraction's value.
That scaled the DENOMINATOR. The question asks what sits on top after the same scaling.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Name the equal pieces the whole was cut into, then count how many of them the question is about.
